links.outcome: Diagnostic accuracy score of LLMs versus physicians on the same 80 pediatric ED cases
links.effect: ChatGPT-4o scored 72.5 and Gemini 1.5 Pro 62.75, versus PED physicians 61.88 (ChatGPT-4o better, p<0.05). EM residents scored 43.75, worse than physicians and chatbots (p<0.01).
links.quote: The best performing chatbots were ChatGPT-4o (score: 72.5) and Gemini 1.5 Pro (score: 62.75), the first performing better (p < 0.05) than PED physicians (score: 61.88).

screen.reason: Evaluates diagnostic accuracy of multiple LLMs versus pediatric emergency physicians on 80 real-world pediatric clinical vignettes without testing a specific deployment practice or safeguard.
